feel.winter: Mild — jacket, not coat. Mid-50s°F days. Rainiest stretch.
feel.spring: Café weather by April–May. Mid-60s to low 70s.
feel.summer: Hot and dry. Highs near 85–87°F. Sea is swimmable.
feel.autumn: September still summer. Rain returns in October.

feel.winter: Cool and damp. 50s°F afternoons, 40s at night. Little snow.
feel.spring: April mixed; May is the sweet spot — 70s and blooming.
feel.summer: Hot, often 88°F+. July–Aug driest. Midday shade weather.
feel.autumn: September still warm. November turns wet and grey.

feel.winter: Cold, foggy, damp. Highs in the mid-40s. Occasional snow.
feel.spring: Fast warm-up. March still cool; May already summer-adjacent.
feel.summer: Hot and humid (not dry-Med). Highs ~87°F. Thunderstorms.
feel.autumn: Warm September, then fog and rain. Darker than the south.

feel.winter: Grey, damp, around freezing (mid-30s). Rare savage cold.
feel.spring: Late. April still raw. May is when it finally opens up.
feel.summer: Mild 65–71°F highs. Long days. Rarely hot. Walking weather.
feel.autumn: September can be lovely. October turns wet and dark.

feel.winter: Real winter: mid-20s to low 30s, snow, ~6 hours of day in Dec.
feel.spring: Slow. Ice can linger into April. May explodes into light.
feel.summer: Pleasant 68–73°F highs, light until 10pm. Archipelago swimming.
feel.autumn: September still usable. Darkness arrives fast after that.

feel.winter: Cold and dark, snowy. Highs around 30°F. Ski country nearby.
feel.spring: April still winter-ish. May is the turning point.
feel.summer: Mild, not hot — ~70°F. Wetter than Stockholm. Endless evenings.
feel.autumn: Colourful September, then rain and early dusk.

feel.winter: Cold, snowy, very dark. Highs around 30°F. Sea can freeze.
feel.spring: Late and dramatic. May is when it suddenly feels livable.
feel.autumn: Crisp, then quickly dark. First snow often November.

feel.winter: Around freezing + wind + wet. Almost no daylight in December.
feel.spring: Still winter-like through April. May is cool and bright.
feel.summer: Cool 52–58°F. Pack a sweater in July. Changeable skies.
feel.autumn: Stormy and wet. Wind is the main character.

feel.winter: Cool and wet. Mid-50s days, mid-40s nights. The rainy season.
feel.spring: Still cool — highs only low 60s. Fog starts to show up.
feel.summer: The famous flat summer: ~66°F highs, fog, almost no rain.
feel.autumn: Warmest stretch is September (Indian summer). Then rain returns.

feel.winter: Real winter. 30s, snow possible, short gray days.
feel.spring: April still raw; May finally opens up into the 70s.
feel.summer: Hot and humid. Highs mid-80s, nights in the 70s. Sticky.
feel.autumn: September is the best month. October crisp. November turns raw.

feel.winter: Mild by northern standards. Highs near 60°F, nights can freeze.
feel.spring: Warms fast. Stormy. Already 77°F highs in April.
feel.summer: Brutal heat. Highs 97°F, nights ~78°F. Dry-ish but oppressive.
feel.autumn: September still hot. October is the relief valve.
